{{Quote|Enjoy the bold taste of Socorro's black sands and rugged Killee Wasteland with this well-done slider. We top a blackened patty with four pieces of crispy tailring bacon and the Monnoks' smoky steak sauce.|Dex's Diner menu, on the Socorro slider|<ref name="Dining at Dex's" />}}
'''Monnoks' smoky steak sauce''' was used to make the [[Socorro slider]]s sold at [[Dex's Diner/Legends|Dex's Diner]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]],<ref name="Dining at Dex's" /> a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] located in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy's]] [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]].<ref name="Atlas">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> The [[Sauce/Legends|sauce]] shared its name with the [[M'onnok]], a type of predator found in the [[Desert/Legends|desert]]s<ref name="Encyclopedia">''[[Star Wars Encyclopedia]]''</ref> on the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]]<ref name="Atlas" /> planet [[Socorro/Legends|Socorro]].<ref name="Encyclopedia" /> The [[slider]] cost 6.7 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] and was inspired by the travels of the diner's [[Chef/Legends|chef]] [[Dexter Jettster/Legends|Dexter Jettster]].<ref name="Dining at Dex's" />

==Behind the scenes==
Monnoks' smoky steak sauce was mentioned in "[[Dining at Dex's]]," an article written by [[Gregory Walker]] as an [[in-universe]] menu for Dex's Diner that was published on the [[Hyperspace: The Official Star Wars Fan Club|Hyperspace]] section of [[StarWars.com]] on [[December 3]], [[2009]].<ref name="Dining at Dex's" />
